notes: Gauge, Rebase and Team Emissions are tracked onchain from HYBR Transfer events emitted by the token contract on HyperEVM.
Launch allocations marked veHYBR are vote-escrowed HYBR, not liquid HYBR at TGE. veHYBR is represented by transferable ERC-721 lock positions.
Genesis Drop, Presale veHYBR, Treasury & Ecosystem veHYBR, Hybra Assistance Fund, and Hybra Research Community veHYBR are marked TBD because the docs do not provide fixed HYBR unlock dates.
Team & Core Contributors is modeled as a 2-year cliff because the docs specify this allocation is veHYBR locked for 2 years.

insiders.methodology: Tracks the team wallets receiving the team share of weekly emissions from the Minter. Received is a running total of an ongoing emission, not a fixed allocation. Staked tracks HYBR locked into veHYBR; these wallets also executed the launch veHYBR locks (Genesis Drop, team and treasury allocations), and veHYBR positions are transferable NFTs, so staked overstates the team's own locked HYBR.

Gauge Emissions.methodology: Tracks HYBR routed from the Minter to the GaugeManager for LP gauge rewards.
